content_of_post_to_comment: We spend so much time teaching children how to say: “Please.” “Thank you.” “I'm sorry.” Let's also teach them: “I need help.” “I don't understand.” “That hurt my feelings.” “I need some space.” Those sentences may serve them for life.
comment: Teaching children to ask for help also changes the adult role: it requires us to respond without rescuing or judging. Maybe the harder lesson is creating spaces where those sentences feel safe to say.
